HORDE.title: Mob Attacker
HORDE.chooseTarget: Choose one target on the current scene
HORDE.authority: Horde actions require the active GM with the alphabetically first user ID. Other users cannot resolve Horde attacks.
HORDE.selectSource: Select exactly one NPC token before continuing.
HORDE.configHint: One token representing eight creatures: enter 8. Eight separate tokens: enter 1 on each and use the same Horde identifier. Progress persists across combat rounds. Use /horde reset only when you want to clear it.
HORDE.attackHint: All allowed attacks against the same target share hit progress, including Multiattack. The attack number reserves a turn slot; it does not split progress. Different targets, groups, bonuses and AC keep separate progress.
HORDE.modeHint: Bonus dice are rolled once for this group. Changing weapon mode or ammunition recalculates an unchanged bonus field. Advantage, disadvantage and critical hits are not used by this table. Damage is rolled; HP is not changed automatically. This visibility controls damage only. All calculations stay GM-only.
HORDE.npcOnly: Enable Horde on an NPC to use this action.
HORDE.duplicate: This token already attacked in that attack number. Use a different number or reset counters.
HORDE.acInvalid: The target has no numeric AC.
HORDE.noAmmo: Not enough ammunition for all attacking creatures.
HORDE.roundChanged: The round changed. Repeat this attack.
HORDE.damageCanceled: Damage was canceled or no damage roll was produced.
HORDE.progress: Attack #{lane}: d20 needed {need}; {threshold} attackers/hit. Counter {before} → {after}; hits {hits}; progress {remainder}/{threshold}.
HORDE.partial: Damage interrupted: {completed}/{total} hits rolled. Counters and ammunition remain committed. Roll the remaining damage manually; do not repeat this attack.
HORDE.resetConfirm: Reset all Horde counters for the current combat or scene? This does not undo damage or restore resources.
HORDE.help: Select one NPC token. Use /horde config to mark it and set its size. Use a weapon, attack spell or attack ability normally. For a manual attack type /horde BONUS | DAMAGE | CREATURES | ATTACKS | NAME. /horde opens the form; /horde reset resets counters. Select multiple NPC tokens and click the group icon on the Token toolbar to toggle them as one Horde. All rules and counters are GM-only.
HORDE.rulesHint: A result above 20 uses 20 creatures per success. Saves use the same table, without criticals. Native spell damage can be distributed across failed and successful saves. Mixed attacks use the strongest profile in each completed group.
HORDE.libWrapper: Mob Attacker requires the libWrapper module enabled.
HORDE.promptUnmarked: Offer Horde on unmarked NPC attacks
HORDE.promptHint: Show a Horde configuration before a normal NPC attack. Disable to prompt only for NPCs already marked as Horde.
HORDE.selectMany: Select at least one NPC token.
HORDE.markedMany: Marked {count} NPC tokens as one Horde.
HORDE.unmarkedMany: Removed Horde marking from {count} NPC tokens.
HORDE.quickToggleHint: Click to toggle Horde. Right-click for all Horde actions.
HORDE.promptMarked: Show a dialog on each marked Horde attack
HORDE.promptMarkedHint: Off: use the selected target and normal attack damage immediately. If there is no single target, the GM target dialog still opens.
HORDE.turnSpent: This initiative participant has already used its attacks this round. Advance initiative or configure its attack limit.
HORDE.activeNPC: The active initiative participant must be an NPC with a token.
HORDE.turnChanged: Initiative changed while configuring the attack. Repeat the action for the active participant.
HORDE.forcedResult: Hit forced by the GM. Rolled one hit and reset this Horde’s progress against this target.
HORDE.damageThroughAttack: Horde damage is rolled by resolving an attack. Use Attack, or Force hit to override the outcome and clear progress.
HORDE.noAttack: No attack activity was found on this NPC sheet.
HORDE.emptyHorde: This Horde has no living creatures. Restore HP or configure its population.
HORDE.populationInfo: Initial creatures: {initial}; living: {current}; HP per creature: {hp}. Changing the count starts a new initial population while retaining damage. Healing can restore members.
HORDE.saveDamage: Damage to one creature (number or dice; optional)
HORDE.saveDamagePlaceholder: Leave blank to use the spell’s native damage roll
HORDE.saveHint: Use the save button on a spell card to read its DC and link its damage, or enter DC and damage manually. Select a forced success count to override the table. All creatures in the token are affected. Resolve each Horde token once per effect.
HORDE.saveSummary: DC {dc}; bonus {bonus}; creatures {count}; successes {successes}; failures {failures}; one success per {threshold}.
HORDE.saveDamageSummary: Damage per failed save: {failed}; per success: {passed}; total Horde damage: {total}.
HORDE.saveAlreadyApplied: These save damages have already been applied or locked.
HORDE.saveStale: HP or population changed since this save. Resolve a new save before applying damage.
HORDE.saveApplied: Damage applied. Horde population and size updated.
HORDE.damageInvalid: Damage must be a nonnegative number.
HORDE.saveDuplicate: This token already resolved this save for this spell. Select forced mode to replace its pending result.
HORDE.splitHPHint: Choose equal or random HP for individual members. Both modes preserve total current HP; each member receives 1 to its base maximum HP.
HORDE.menuUnmarked: Configure this NPC to enable Horde actions.
HORDE.sizeThresholdHint: Minimum living creatures for this size. Thresholds for each base size must increase (2–200). Saved changes also resize existing Horde tokens.
HORDE.mergeDone: Merged {count} creatures into one Horde token.
HORDE.mergeSelect: Select at least two individual NPC tokens to merge, or use this button on one Horde token to split it.
HORDE.mergeInitiativeHint: Choose the highest, median or lowest rolled initiative of the merged creatures. Unrolled entries are ignored. With an even number of results, median uses the higher of the two middle values.
